exposed_pad.note: 5-pin TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5, Case 483, 3.00 x 1.50 x 0.95 mm) has NO exposed pad (EPAD applies only to UDFN4 package).

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: TSOP-5 single component mounted on 1 oz FR-4 PCB with 645 mm^2 Cu area (Note 3; UDFN4 is 170 °C/W)

tj_max_c.condition: Absolute Maximum Junction Temperature TJ(MAX) = 150°C (electrical specs characterized over -40°C <= TJ <= 85°C; TSD typ 160°C)

pinout.name: IN
pinout.description: Input voltage pin (1.7 V to 5.5 V operating, 6.0 V abs max); connect >= 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitor.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high Enable input (VEN_HI >= 0.9 V, VEN_LO <= 0.4 V) with internal 300 nA pulldown current source.

pinout.name: N/C
pinout.description: Not internally connected; onsemi permits tying Pin 4 to GND to improve thermal dissipation.

pinout.name: OUT
pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output with 100 Ohm active discharge ('A' version); requires 1 uF nominal (>= 0.22 uF effective) ceramic cap with ESR < 2 Ohm.

vin_abs_max_v.condition: Absolute maximum VIN and VEN (-0.3 V to 6 V; VOUT = -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V or 6 V)

vin_min_v.condition: Operating input voltage minimum across family (maintain VIN >= 3.3 V + VDO for 3.3 V regulation)

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V active-discharge ('A' version) TSOP-5 option (Marking 'CAL')

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: ±2% over -40°C <= TJ <= 85°C for VOUT > 2.0 V (±1% at room temperature per p.1 Features)

iout_max_ma.condition: 300 mA rated continuous load (ICL = 300 mA min / 600 mA typ at 90% VOUT; ISC = 630 mA typ, p.13)

iq_typ_ua.condition: Ground current IQ at IOUT = 0 mA, TJ = +25°C (95 uA max over -40..+85°C; dynamic IQ rises under load)

ishdn_typ_ua.condition: 0.01 uA (10 nA) typ, 1 uA max at VEN <= 0.4 V, VIN = 5.5 V (p.1 bullet rounds to 0.1 uA)

dropout_typ_mv.condition: TSOP-5 package specifically: 150 mV typ, 225 mV max at IOUT = 300 mA, VOUT = 3.3 V (p.1 headline 135 mV typ / 200 mV max applies ONLY to UDFN4, Note 5)

psrr_db.condition: f = 1 kHz, VIN = 3.6 V, VOUT = 3.1 V, IOUT = 150 mA

output_noise_uvrms.condition: f = 10 Hz to 100 kHz, VIN = 2.5 V, VOUT = 1.8 V, IOUT = 150 mA

min_cout_uf.condition: 1 uF nominal X5R/X7R ceramic recommended; stable down to 0.22 uF minimum effective capacitance after DC-bias and temperature derating

esr_max_ohm.condition: No minimum ESR requirement; maximum COUT ESR must be less than 2 Ohm (tantalum capacitors discouraged due to high cold-temp ESR)

design_gotchas.title: TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5) Has Worse Dropout (150 mV), Load Reg (28 mV), and RθJA (236 C/W) Than Page-1 UDFN Specs
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 advertises 135 mV typical dropout, which belongs ONLY to the 1x1 mm UDFN4 package. For NCP114ASN330T1G in TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5, Case 483), Page 3 specifies 150 mV typ / 225 mV max dropout at 300 mA, 28 mV typ / 45 mV max load regulation (vs 12/30 mV for UDFN4), and RθJA = 236 °C/W (vs 170 °C/W for UDFN4).

design_gotchas.title: Operating Junction Temperature Characterized Only Up to +85 C (Not +125 C)
design_gotchas.detail: Although TJ(MAX) abs max is 150 °C, all Electrical Characteristics on Page 3 and the PD(MAX) formula on Page 13 (`PD(MAX) = (85°C - TA) / RθJA`) limit specified operation to TJ <= +85 °C — significantly stricter than TI's 125 °C-rated DBV SOT-23-5 LDOs (TLV755P, TPS7A20, TLV733P).

design_gotchas.title: No Reverse-Current Protection — Body Diode Conducts When VOUT > VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Page 14 explicitly states that the PMOS pass transistor's inherent body diode forward-biases whenever VOUT exceeds VIN, requiring external Schottky protection in applications subject to back-biasing or fast VIN collapse.

design_gotchas.title: High 75 dB PSRR (1 kHz) With Active Discharge ('A' Version) & Low-Height TSOP-5 Body
design_gotchas.detail: NCP114ASN330T1G ('A' version, Marking 'CAL') includes 100 Ohm active output discharge (unlike 'B' version NCP114BSN330T1G) and a 300 nA internal EN pulldown. TSOP-5 (Case 483, 0.95 mm max height) is a thin-profile TSOT-23-5 package sharing the standard 0.95 mm-pitch 5-pin footprint (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT).

typical_use_cases: Low-profile (<1 mm height) 300 mA Bluetooth, ZigBee, GPS, and WLAN 3.3 V rails needing 75 dB PSRR at 1 kHz
Single-cell Li-Ion portable devices requiring 150 mV typical dropout, 10 nA shutdown, and 100 Ohm active discharge
Cost-effective second-source TSOT-23-5 / SOT-23-5 footprint alternative when TJ stays <= 85°C and VIN <= 5.5 V
Compact 0402 ceramic-decoupled 3.3 V sub-rails stable down to 0.22 uF effective output capacitance
engineering_summary: The onsemi NCP114ASN330T1G is a 300 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2% over -40°C to +85°C) CMOS LDO in a low-profile TSOP-5 (TSOT-23-5, Case 483) package with standard 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN (active high, 300 nA internal pulldown), 4=N/C, 5=OUT pinout and 100 Ohm active output discharge. Operating from 1.7 V to 5.5 V (6 V abs max), it achieves 75 dB PSRR at 1 kHz, 70 uVRMS noise, 50 uA no-load IQ, 0.01 uA shutdown current, 150 mV typical dropout (TSOP-5) at 300 mA, and 1 uF ceramic cap stability (ESR < 2 Ohm). Engineers must note its +85°C operating TJ specification ceiling, 236 °C/W RθJA, and lack of reverse-current blocking.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision verified page 1 TSOP-5 (SN Suffix, Case 483) Top View pinout: 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=N/C, 5=OUT (no exposed pad).
300 DPI PNG Vision verified page 2 Abs Max (VIN=6V, VEN=6V, TJ_max=150C) and Thermal Characteristics specifically for TSOP-5 (RθJA=236 C/W vs UDFN4 170 C/W).

300 DPI PNG Vision verified page 3 Electrical Characteristics (-40..+85C TJ, VIN=1.7..5.5V, ±2% accuracy for >2.0V, TSOP-5 VDO=150mV typ / 225mV max @300mA/3.3V [vs UDFN 135/200mV], IQ=50uA typ, IDIS=0.01uA typ, PSRR=75dB @1kHz, VN=70uVrms, RDIS=100Ohm for Version A).

Path A page 13-14 confirmed 1 uF nominal / 0.22 uF effective COUT, <2 Ohm max ESR, 85C PD(MAX) derating equation, and PMOS body diode reverse current; page 16 confirmed OPN NCP114ASN330T1G = TSOP-5, 3.3V, Marking 'CAL', with active output discharge.
